notes.title: Tragedy of Prince Rupert 1.5 is now live!!
notes.content:
I am very happy to announce the release of Tragedy of Prince Rupert version 1.5 - a special long-awaited update with a focus on balancing, polishing and bugfixes.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29683861/5764b843f576857ab33f187dfd4c0c7c37ea7190.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] 16 perks added
[*] new crew member: the Doctor (reach level 10 to unlock, achievement included)
[*] heavy engine optimalization (finally runs on toasters)
[*] many of new visual details and effects
[*] more sounds
[*] stats added
[*] all known bugs fixed
[*] french version added (I expect hype on Champs-Élysées)
[/list]

You can leave review or feedback on the community page or PM me with suggestions.

Thank you!

Spytihněv
